ModManifest.Name: PawnMind · AI Bridge
ModManifest.Author: local
ModManifest.Description:
Local MCP bridge for Probably Stolen (experimental, M0).
Starts a read-only HTTP endpoint on 127.0.0.1 that exposes a compact snapshot of what the player can currently see in the shop. The token is generated on first enable and stored in the game's ModData directory.
No gameplay action is executed in M0. The server binds to loopback only and requires a bearer token; it never reads hidden fields (appraisal truth, hidden customer identity).
